notes.title: Spring Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Spring update releasing tomorrow March 25, 2021!
We will add new weapons, support for the Korean language and the "Death Impact" feature, that will greatly change your slashing experience.

[About Death Impact]
You will be able blow away enemies with the final blow!
Works with all weapons and shields and the distance depends on the weapon.
We personally recommend the "Battle Hammer", which is currently available as an event reward, for the best results!

notes.title: Flaming Swords light up the next big update!
notes.notes:
Our next big update is coming very soon, and we're adding some new exciting weapons; a pair of flaming samurai swords!  Slicing up some baddies with these katanas is gonna be fun.

Meet the 2 new swords, with flames engraved in their designs...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33507112/95f937038eee504178a9caaa45d9461c85d1296d.jpg

Suzaku and Phoenix are both one-handed swords:
- Suzaku: An attack type sword with a length similar to regular swords.
- Phoenix: A defensive type with a length similar to shortswords.

When you use them together as a combo not only will you look good, but you will be a tough battle for any gargantuan enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33507112/f1d6f59501ebf8b970fbb1194ad015f5cdf3a8f9.png

We'll be holding an event where you can earn these swords in-game individually.

notes.title: Patch Notes - February 14 - Ver.1.2.8.24771
notes.notes:
Version upgrade information:

Regarding health recovery from shields, the following rules have been implemented:

・While weapon is in a normal/cracked state:
Health can be recovered when equipped.

・While weapon is broken:
Health can not be recovered when equipped.
Shield will automatically be removed to the available equipment slot,
and can be equipped once more after clearing the current battle.

=========================================================================

Ver.1.2.8.24753

- Changed the menu UI.
- Added the possibility to wear the shield on the waist.
- Fixed sync so that other players can see if the shield is broken in multiplayer.
- Added new weapons for the event.
- Changed the items in the Adventure mode shop.
- Fixed a bug that caused the player rank to be 1.

=========================================================================

Important: About Taking Back Artifacts
Thank you for your support and for playing "SWORDS of GARGANTUA".

We have an announcement regarding the artifacts of Adventure mode.
In order to reduce inventory, we will change the characteristics of acquired artifacts as follows:

Update date and time
Friday, 27th February 2020, 23:00 (scheduled)

Update contents
・All acquired and purchased artifacts will not be taken back with you after clearing the stage. 
・Artifacts owned by the time of the update will be converted into coins after maintenance.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: December 27th Update
notes.notes:
Hi @everyone we have a small update today, patch note below.:


・ Shop lineup in adventure mode has been updated.

Additionally there is a known issue which has been highlighted.

In the case where players collect over 1100 items in adventure mode, they will be unable to see those items over the 1100th item. We are aware of this issue and are now looking into resoling this issue. Apologies if you are affected by this.
To clarify, these items remain in your inventory, and if you sell or dispose of any items to bring the excess count to 1100 or below you will see any items considered "missing". This is simply a display issue. Once we have a fix we'll let you know. 

- Yomuneco Team

notes.title: Update ver. 1.0. 0.20098
notes.notes:
[Highlight Updates]
Update finished (ver. 1.0. 0.20098)
The main contents of the update are as follows.

- New
*Added “Restart” to a single quest
 Displayed when the menu button is pressed during a single quest.
*Added "Free" to character rotation
as you type.
*Added some key configurations of the HTC VIVE
 You can set a trigger and grip swap
*Added ranking for high score challenge
 The ranking is displayed only when an event is held.
*Added Toy Items to Multi Lobby

- Modify
*Change the damage of Enemy's kick attack to zero
 You became easier to achieve the single target of "No damage and clear"
*Adjustment of Enemy's attack decision
 You become easier to protect against Enemy's attack.
*Adjust the enchant effect 

*Adjust scoring method for single quests
 Clear time affects score in milliseconds
 Combo hit ratio affects score to decimal point

*Fixed LIV bug
 Fixed Inappropriate hand display.
 Fixed Crash in a multi-quest

*Oculus Store Modifies Game Player Name To Change When You Rename On Steam
 * Currently, Oculus Quest is not supported.

*Announcements, Credits Adjust display scroll

*Fixed other minor corrections

notes.title: Release Celebration Campaign!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the official launch of "SWORDS OF GARGANTUA", we are holding a release celebration campaign! 

If players boot up Swords of Gargantua at least once before 23:59 Friday, June 20, you can unlock a unique sword! You'll receive the sword in an upcoming update shortly after the campaign end date.

Crimson Sword 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33507112/ddbc08c266a5e4ce63ea7361d079de5f265dd31d.png

The Crimson Sword is a one-handed sword forged in the maker's own blood. It is shrouded with a sinister aura. 

We hope to see you in-game!

[NOTE] 
*The update date is subject to change. 
*The performance of the Crimson Sword is equivalent to that of the Sword Lv2.

notes.title: Swords of Gargantua Release Date Set! June 6th!
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We're very happy to announce that Sword of Gargantua will be released on June 6th on Steam! (That's North America based btw, in Asia please expect it on the 7th) 

Whether you use a HTC VIVE, Oculus Rift or Window Mixed Reality HMD, you'll be able to band together and take down the Gargantua through cross-play with other players on other platforms!

Be sure to wishlist us so you get the notification when the game goes live!

See you in-game!

Yomuneco Team
